contract.summary: Paginated event listings must produce a sequence identical to a single unpaginated fetch, without duplicate records or ordering changes between pages.
invariants: When fetching events with pagination parameters (e.g., limit/offset or page/size), each page must return a contiguous, non‑overlapping slice of the total ordered result set.
The concatenation of all paginated pages, in page order, must be exactly the same ordered list as retrieving all events in one request without pagination.
inputs: A request to the events endpoint with pagination parameters (page number and page size, or limit and offset) under normal, static dataset conditions.
A request to the same endpoint without any pagination parameters to retrieve the full list.
expected_outputs: Each paginated response contains a list of events sorted according to the API’s defined ordering (e.g., by event start time, ID, etc.).
No event appears in more than one paginated response.
The ordered list obtained by concatenating the paginated responses matches exactly the ordered list returned by the unpaginated request.
out_of_scope: Changes to the underlying data (e.g., events being added, removed, or updated) between paginated requests.
Performance characteristics of pagination (query speed, latency).
User interface rendering of the paginated data.
Any filtering, search, or authorization logic not directly related to pagination.
ambiguities: Exact pagination mechanism used by the API (offset‑based vs page‑number‑based).
The default sorting key and direction applied to the event list.
Whether any hidden filters or default query parameters affect the result set.
The size of the dataset required to reliably reproduce the issue.

+"""Final verification test for pagination fix."""
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pagination_fix_verification(client):
+    """Verify that the pagination off-by-one issue is fixed."""
+    
+    # Get all events without pagination
+    all_response = await client.get("/events")
+    all_events = all_response.json()
+    all_ids = [e["id"] for e in all_events["items"]]
+    total = all_events["total"]
+    
+    print(f"\n=== Pagination Fix Verification ===")
+    print(f"Total events: {total}")
+    print(f"All events (unpaginated): {all_ids}")
+    
+    # Test case 1: offset=0, limit=2 (first page)
+    page1 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 0})
+    page1_ids = [e["id"] for e in page1.json()["items"]]
+    print(f"\nPage 1 (offset=0, limit=2): {page1_ids}")
+    assert page1_ids == [3, 1], f"Expected [3, 1], got {page1_ids}"
+    
+    # Test case 2: offset=2, limit=2 (second page)
+    page2 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 2})
+    page2_ids = [e["id"] for e in page2.json()["items"]]
+    print(f"Page 2 (offset=2, limit=2): {page2_ids}")
+    assert page2_ids == [2], f"Expected [2], got {page2_ids}"
+    
+    # Test case 3: Verify no overlap between pages
+    page1_set = set(page1_ids)
+    page2_set = set(page2_ids)
+    overlap = page1_set.intersection(page2_set)
+    print(f"Overlap between pages: {overlap}")
+    assert len(overlap) == 0, f"Pages should not overlap, but found: {overlap}"
+    
+    # Test case 4: Concatenate all pages and verify it matches unpaginated
+    concatenated = page1_ids + page2_ids
+    print(f"\nConcatenated pages: {concatenated}")
+    print(f"Unpaginated: {all_ids}")
+    assert concatenated == all_ids, f"Concatenated pages should match unpaginated"
+    
+    # Test case 5: Test with limit=1 (most granular)
+    print(f"\n=== Testing with limit=1 ===")
+    paginated_ids = []
+    for offset in range(0, total):
+        page = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 1, "offset": offset})
+        page_ids = [e["id"] for e in page.json()["items"]]
+        paginated_ids.extend(page_ids)
+        print(f"Offset {offset}: {page_ids}")
+    
+    print(f"All paginated (limit=1): {paginated_ids}")
+    assert paginated_ids == all_ids, f"Expected {all_ids}, got {paginated_ids}"
+    
+    # Test case 6: Verify no duplicates in any pagination scenario
+    assert len(paginated_ids) == len(set(paginated_ids)), "Duplicate events found"
+    
+    print(f"\n✓ All pagination tests passed!")

+"""Comprehensive test to verify pagination works correctly."""
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pagination_comprehensive(client):
+    """Test that all paginated pages concatenate to match unpaginated results."""
+    # Get all events without pagination
+    all_events = await client.get("/events")
+    all_ids = [e["id"] for e in all_events.json()["items"]]
+    total = all_events.json()["total"]
+    
+    print(f"All events: {all_ids}")
+    print(f"Total: {total}")
+    
+    # Test with limit=1 (most granular)
+    paginated_ids = []
+    for offset in range(0, total):
+        page = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 1, "offset": offset})
+        page_ids = [e["id"] for e in page.json()["items"]]
+        paginated_ids.extend(page_ids)
+        print(f"Offset {offset}: {page_ids}")
+    
+    print(f"Paginated (limit=1): {paginated_ids}")
+    assert paginated_ids == all_ids, f"Expected {all_ids}, got {paginated_ids}"
+    
+    # Test with limit=2
+    paginated_ids = []
+    for offset in range(0, total, 2):
+        page = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": offset})
+        page_ids = [e["id"] for e in page.json()["items"]]
+        paginated_ids.extend(page_ids)
+        print(f"Offset {offset}: {page_ids}")
+    
+    print(f"Paginated (limit=2): {paginated_ids}")
+    assert paginated_ids == all_ids, f"Expected {all_ids}, got {paginated_ids}"
+    
+    # Verify no duplicates
+    assert len(paginated_ids) == len(set(paginated_ids)), "Duplicate events found in pagination"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pagination_no_overlap(client):
+    """Test that pages don't overlap."""
+    # Get page 1
+    page1 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 0})
+    page1_ids = [e["id"] for e in page1.json()["items"]]
+    
+    # Get page 2
+    page2 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 2})
+    page2_ids = [e["id"] for e in page2.json()["items"]]
+    
+    # Verify no overlap
+    page1_set = set(page1_ids)
+    page2_set = set(page2_ids)
+    overlap = page1_set.intersection(page2_set)
+    
+    assert len(overlap) == 0, f"Pages overlap: {overlap}"
+    print(f"Page 1: {page1_ids}")
+    print(f"Page 2: {page2_ids}")
+    print(f"No overlap: ✓")

+"""Test to verify pagination off-by-one issue."""
+import pytest
+from httpx import AsyncClient
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_pagination_concatenation():
+    """Test that paginated results match unpaginated results."""
+    async with AsyncClient(app=app, base_url="http://test") as client:
+        # Get all events without pagination
+        all_events = await client.get("/events")
+        all_ids = [e["id"] for e in all_events.json()["items"]]
+        
+        # Get events with pagination
+        page1 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 0})
+        page2 = await client.get("/events", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 2})
+        
+        page1_ids = [e["id"] for e in page1.json()["items"]]
+        page2_ids = [e["id"] for e in page2.json()["items"]]
+        
+        # Concatenate paginated results
+        paginated_ids = page1_ids + page2_ids
+        
+        print(f"All events: {all_ids}")
+        print(f"Page 1: {page1_ids}")
+        print(f"Page 2: {page2_ids}")
+        print(f"Paginated: {paginated_ids}")
+        
+        # They should match
+        assert paginated_ids == all_ids, f"Expected {all_ids}, got {paginated_ids}"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    from app.main import app
+    import asyncio
+    asyncio.run(test_pagination_concatenation())
